lead.headline: Achane Hurt Early as Chem Slips Toward 0–3
lead.deck: Footballers lead 133.4 to 103.8 and only your bench is left to play. The bigger story is Miami's knee.
lead.byline: BY THE BRIEF DESK · 21:20 MEXICO CITY
lead.body: De'Von Achane left on Miami's fifth play with a non-contact knee injury and never returned; Jeff Hafley said afterwards it doesn't sound optimistic. Justin Jefferson was ruled out with an ankle in Minnesota's win. Jaylen Warren did his job — 20.6 on a 15.8 projection with Dowdle out — and Garrett Wilson's 26.7 led the roster, but Coker (3.8) and Likely (3.3) gave little back. The bench outscored them: McLaurin 19.7, Tuten 17.0. ESPN puts the week at 1%. The decisions that matter now are Tuesday's: who covers Achane, and whether Jefferson's ankle costs a week.

doFirst.headline: One Move, Two Weeks Out
doFirst.deck: Nothing to do tonight. Week 6 still needs a defence — and Achane's knee may bring the bye problem forward.

cards.reason: Achane, Jefferson and the Vikings D/ST are all on bye in week 6. The bench covers two of them; nobody covers the defence.
